efb.tagline: The pilot's electronic flight bag for Cerulean Aviation Network

account.signedOutHint: Sign in to see your own flight plans and logbook

dashboard.title: Overview
dashboard.description: What this flight needs first: the plan, the weather, the notices.

flightplan.title: Flight plan
flightplan.description: File, submit and track your flight plan.

charts.title: Charts
charts.description: Airport diagrams, SIDs, STARs and approaches.

placeholder.title: Nothing here yet
placeholder.body: The frame lands first: shell, navigation, theme and languages are in place. The content waits on can-api being wired up.

reasons.charts: Charts are copyrighted data and nothing on the network serves them today. This page waits on a source — licensed or our own.

notFound.title: No such page
notFound.body: The address may be wrong, or this page has not been built yet.

notice.imported: Imported from SimBrief — check it over before filing.
notice.invalid: Some fields need fixing; see the ones marked below.
notice.tracked: {controller} is holding this aircraft's radar track, so the plan is theirs to amend.
notice.notLinked: No SimBrief account linked yet — link one in Settings.

errors.cruiseTas: True airspeed must be a positive number.
errors.time: Time must be four digits, HHMM.
errors.route: Route is too long or contains characters that are not accepted.
errors.structural: No colons or newlines — they would split the FSD packet apart.

draft.kept: The form already had content; nothing was overwritten.
draft.published: This routing is the one the AIP publishes.
draft.computed: This routing is a shortest path computed over the airway network, not a published one.

weather.empty: No airports yet. Enter a four-letter ICAO code to start.
weather.noReport: No METAR is available for this station.

route.noPoints: This route resolved to no waypoints.
route.navdataUnavailable: Navigation data is not deployed on this instance, so routes cannot be expanded. It is AIRAC commercial data and never ships in a public image.
route.disclaimer: Distances are great-circle between consecutive points. No wind, and no allowance for how a SID or STAR actually flies — do not plan fuel from this.

map.label: Route map: the resolved waypoints joined as a great-circle track

generate.title: Generate a route
generate.belowMtca: **Cruise level is below the route's minimum terrain clearance**
generate.noRoute: No routing between these two airports (another cruise level may work).
generate.badInput: Airport codes must be four-letter ICAO.
generate.failed: Could not generate a route — try again shortly.

account.title: Account
account.hint: This comes from your network account. Change it on the main site.
account.name: Name

simbrief.title: SimBrief
simbrief.hint: Link an account to pull your latest OFP into the flight plan page in one click.

local.title: This device
local.hint: Stored on this device only; never synced to your account.
local.railHint: Shrinks the rail to a column of icons and gives the width back to the page.
local.themeHint: Theme and language are at the foot of the sidebar.

empty.title: Nothing on the map yet
empty.body: Resolve a route and it will be drawn here. Routes are the only geographic data this network has today — weather is raw METAR text, live traffic lives on the radar site, and charts are licensed data.

airports.search: Search by ICAO, name or FIR

denied.title: Your account cannot read the aeronautical database yet
denied.body: Airport data comes from the aeronautical database. Read access is granted per member by an administrator; instructors (rating 8 and above) have it automatically. This is not a fault — ask an administrator if you need it.

error.title: Aeronautical data is temporarily unavailable
error.body: The aeronautical database did not answer. This is a fault rather than a permissions problem — try again shortly.
